purpose: Manual documentation-drift checklist until 44.0.3 adds an enforced consistency gate.

required_claim_terms.source_proof: checked under the named compiler, solver, and proof profile
required_claim_terms.release_evidence: verified from bundle-local evidence and the approved public key
required_claim_terms.local_simulation: simulated under the named local target profile
required_claim_terms.testnet_action: observed through the explicit selected testnet endpoint

required_exclusions: target runtime and chain consensus correctness
review_rule: A product-claim document is not accepted when it conflicts with the authoritative lock, omits a required exclusion, or uses a prohibited claim without a narrower qualified statement.
